biography.value:
黑暗中的某處傳來斷斷續續的咕嚕呻吟聲。一個拖着殘腿，舉着腫脹胳臂和破損手掌的身影，蹣跚地出現在視野。殭屍不停的前進，摧毀任何未能逃脫的生物。

    黑暗奴僕Dark Servants。罪惡的死靈魔法將活力灌注到死者的遺骸中，將他們以殭屍的形式復甦，並以此無畏而堅定的執行創造者的指示。它們的步伐笨拙而可笑，身上披裹的是已經腐壞發臭的生前皮囊。

    絕大多數殭屍由類人生物的遺骸製成，事實上擁有類似骨肉結構的生物都可以被製作成這種生命形式。活化殭屍的死靈魔法通常來自法術。更有一些殭屍直接從滲透着黑暗魔力的地區自發復甦。成爲殭屍的生物無法輕易復原，也只有諸如復生術resurrection一類的強力法術才能實現。

    殭屍不保留任何自我的生前痕跡。其意識不帶任何的思維能力。未接受指令的殭屍會站在原地繼續腐朽直到某些它能夠殺死的生物路過。活化殭屍的法術向其灌輸了大量的邪惡，因而即使沒有目標，殭屍也會攻擊任何遭遇的活物。

    駭人形體Hideous Forms。殭屍保留着曾經的樣子，甚至還帶着那些曾經殺死自己的傷口。只是製造這些邪惡生物的魔法經常需要花一些時間才能起效。陣亡武者從戰場上爬起時，連日的暴曬可能已令其內臟盡失且極度腫脹。埋在土裏的粘着泥巴的農夫屍體，則是用那已經長滿蛆蟲的雙手由內向外掘開自己的墳跺。也有的殭屍，則是被衝上灘塗或是從沼澤中浮起，並且由於長時間泡在水中而腐爛發臭。

    無腦士兵Mindless Soldiers。殭屍們只管筆直地衝向目標，從來不去考慮障礙物、戰術和危險地形。一個殭屍會衝到湍急的河流中去追擊河對岸的目標，還會頂着滾石和攻擊攀爬巖壁。殭屍爲攻擊樓下的敵人，會直接從窗戶的開口跳出去。他們會毫不猶豫的衝進咆哮的地獄之火中，強酸的池塘裏，以及任何長滿荊棘的地帶。
    殭屍可以遵循簡單的命令並且能夠分辨敵我。但其理解能力的侷限使其只能蹣跚的順着被指使的方向前進，並攻擊沿路的所有敵人。殭屍會使用已經裝備好的武器，但沒有先關指使時，它們並不會撿起脫手的武器和其他工具。

    不死本質Undead Nature。殭屍不需要空氣，飲食和睡眠。

“貝克Beek死後，我們在他的屍體上施展了一個操縱屍體animate dead法術。開始的時候還挺有趣的，後來這殭屍的味道越來越糟，於是我們把它泡到油裏點着。要是貝克還在，他肯定覺得這特別好玩。”

方金砂峯Fonkin Hoddypeak，致友誼

From somewhere in the darkness, a gurgling moan is heard. A form lurches into view, dragging one foot as it raises bloated arms and broken hands. The zombie advances, driven to kill anyone too slow to escape its grasp.

Dark Servants. Sinister necromantic magic infuses the remains of the dead, causing them to rise as zombies that do their creator's bidding without fear or hesitation. They move with a jerky, uneven gait, clad in the moldering apparel they wore when put to rest, and carrying the stench of decay.

Most zombies are made from humanoid remains, though the flesh and bones of any formerly living creature can be imbued with a semblance of life. Necromantic magic, usually from spells, animates a zombie. Some zombies rise spontaneously when dark magic saturates an area. Once turned into a zombie, a creature can't be restored to life except by powerful magic, such as a @spell[resurrection] spell.

A zombie retains no vestiges of its former self, its mind devoid of thought and imagination. A zombie left without orders simply stands in place and rots unless something comes along that it can kill. The magic animating a zombie imbues it with evil, so left without purpose, it attacks any living creature it encounters.

Hideous Forms. Zombies appear as they did in life, showing the wounds that killed them. However, the magic that creates these vile creatures often takes time to run its course. Dead warriors might rise from a battlefield, eviscerated and bloated after days in the sun. The muddy cadaver of a peasant could claw its way from the ground, riddled with maggots and worms. A zombie might wash ashore or rise from a marsh, swollen and reeking after weeks in the water.

Mindless Soldiers. Zombies take the most direct route to any foe, unable to comprehend obstacles, tactics, or dangerous terrain. A zombie might stumble into a fast-flowing river to reach foes on a far shore, clawing at the surface as it is battered against rocks and destroyed. To reach a foe below it, a zombie might step out of an open window. Zombies stumble through roaring infernos, into pools of acid, and across fields littered with caltrops without hesitation.

A zombie can follow simple orders and distinguish friends from foes, but its ability to reason is limited to shambling in whatever direction it is pointed, pummeling any enemy in its path. A zombie armed with a weapon uses it, but the zombie won't retrieve a dropped weapon or other tool until told to do so.

Undead Nature. A zombie doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

“After Beek died, we cast an @spell[animate dead] spell on his corpse. It was fun for a while, but the zombie started to smell real bad, so we doused it in oil and set it on fire. Beek would've found that hilarious.”

— Fonkin Hoodypeak, on friendship

description.value:
近戰武器攻擊：命中+3，觸及5尺，單一目標。命中：14（4d6）點穿刺傷害。

Melee Weapon Attack: [[/r 1d20+3]]{+3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 ([[/damage 4d6 type=piercing]]) damage.

殭屍從下列選項中隨機選擇發射一束魔法眼波射線，並指定身邊60尺內它可以看到的一個目標。

  • @UUID[.hddBrOtEvz5NVA6j]{1. 麻痹射線}
  • @UUID[.GVpOtT8CUGM5WErg]{2. 恐懼射線}
  • @UUID[.5bnd1LKvX152dqqE]{3. 弱能射線}
  • @UUID[.2se1ErmUGyS1k6vD]{4. 解離射線}

The zombie uses a random magical eye ray, choosing a target that it can see within 60 feet of it.

  • @UUID[.hddBrOtEvz5NVA6j]{1. Paralyzing Ray}
  • @UUID[.GVpOtT8CUGM5WErg]{2. Fear Ray}
  • @UUID[.5bnd1LKvX152dqqE]{3. Enervation Ray}
  • @UUID[.2se1ErmUGyS1k6vD]{4. Disintegration Ray}

items.name: 眼波射線1. 麻痹射線Eye Ray: 1. Paralyzing Ray

description.value:
目標必須進行一次DC 14的體質豁免，豁免失敗者將麻痹1分鐘。該目標可以在每個其自己回合結束時再次進行該豁免，豁免成功則終止該效應。

The targeted creature must succeed on a [[/save ability=con dc=14]] saving throw or be &Reference[condition=paralyzed] for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: 眼波射線2. 恐懼射線Eye Ray: 2. Fear Ray

description.value:
目標必須進行一次DC 14的感知豁免，豁免失敗者將陷入恐慌1分鐘。該目標可以在每個其自己回合結束時再次進行該豁免，豁免成功則終止該效應。

The targeted creature must succeed on a [[/save ability=wis dc=14]] saving throw or be &Reference[condition=frightened] for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: 眼波射線3. 弱能射線Eye Ray: 3. Enervation Ray

description.value:
目標必須進行一次DC 14的體質豁免，豁免失敗者將受到36（8d8）點黯蝕傷害，豁免成功則傷害減半。

The targeted creature must make a [[/save ability=con dc=14]] saving throw, taking 36 ([[/damage 8d8 type=necrotic]]) damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: 眼波射線4. 解離射線Eye Ray: 4. Disintegration Ray

description.value:
目標必須進行一次DC 14的敏捷豁免，豁免失敗者將受到45（10d8）點力場傷害，如果該傷害將目標的生命值降至0，則其身體將化爲一堆灰塵。

如果目標是一個大型或更小體型的非魔法物件或魔法造物，則它的豁免直接失敗。如果目標是巨型或更大體型的非魔法物件或魔法造物，則解離射線可以分解其中10立方尺的部分區域。

If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a [[/save ability=dex dc=14]] saving throw or take 45 ([[/damage 10d8 type=force]]) damage. If this damage reduces the creature to 0 hit points, its body becomes a pile of fine gray dust.

If the target is a Large or smaller nonmagical object or creation of magical force, it is disintegrated without a saving throw. If the target is a Huge or larger nonmagical object or creation of magical force, this ray disintegrates a 10-foot cube of it.

當殭屍因受非光耀非重擊傷害而使其生命值減至0時，它必須進行一次DC爲5＋所受傷害值的體質豁免，豁免成功則生命值降至1。

If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.
